title: AI / ML Engineer
description_preview:
DEPLOY's Client's Cyber Works and Digital Engineering
teams in
Huntsville, Alabama
design, build, and integrate emerging AI/ML technologies to harden and secure the systems that defend the nation, across ground, missile defense, space, and installation infrastructure S&T programs. We're expanding our Secure AI practice to build and assure trusted, robust AI/ML solutions that interpret complex datasets, predict outcomes, and automate decision-making in support of critical military platforms.
This is a consolidated announcement covering multiple tracks; your assignment may emphasize one or a blend of: Classic ML & Predictive Modeling, LLM/GenAI Applications, AI Assurance & Responsible AI, Edge AI/ML Deployment, and hardening AI/ML systems against adversarial threats. All tracks require independent research, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to clearly communicate complex technical work to stakeholders.
Core Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain machine learning models, from classical algorithms (regression, tree ensembles, clustering) to modern deep learning architectures.
Build LLM-enabled applications and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including vector embedding generation, vector database integration, and prompt/context engineering.
Develop AI assurance and evaluation tooling: robustness testing, bias/fairness analysis, model traceability, red-team/adversarial testing, and audit artifact generation.
Optimize and deploy models for production and edge environments (quantization, compression, containerized inference, ONNX/TensorRT).
Implement secure model and data pipelines, defend against adversarial ML threats, and ensure supply-chain integrity (SBOM) for AI components.
Conduct data processing/analysis to improve model accuracy; document and present development processes and assurance evidence to stakeholders.
Contribute to Agile, team-based planning and estimating in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in CS/CPE/EE/Data Science (or related field).
Proven experience in one or more: ML/LLM development, assurance/evaluation tooling, or deploying edge computing solutions.
Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
Proficiency in Python and at least one additional language (Java, C++).
Strong understanding of data structures, data modeling, and software architecture.
Highlighted Skills & Experience:
Modern AI: LLM frameworks and application development; vector embeddings and vector databases; RAG architectures; prompt/context engineering; LLM fine-tuning; model evaluation and benchmarking.
Classic ML: Feature engineering, model selection/tuning, statistical analysis, and predictive modeling across structured and unstructured data.
AI Assurance: Responsible AI practices (robustness, bias/fairness, traceability); adversarial ML defenses; red-team testing; auditability and compliance documentation.
Edge & Deployment: ONNX/TensorRT, quantization/compression, ARM/NVIDIA Jetson/DSP targets, containerized inference, MLOps in controlled/classified environments.
Platform & DevSecOps: REST APIs, CI/CD for software and ML systems, SAST/DAST, Infrastructure-as-Code, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Domain: Familiarity with computer networking, secure system integration for mission platforms, and test/V&V support (Python/MATLAB analysis).
Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects; experience deploying AI models in production, classified, or embedded environments.
Understanding of computer security principles and secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.
Why This Role Matters:
You'll join a high-impact team solving some of the DoD's hardest problems in AI-enabled system security, building the next generation of trusted, auditable, and mission-ready AI for national defense.

For the past 43 years, DEPLOY's client has provided industry-leading technical and engineering solutions in the fields of Defense, Energy, Space, and Environment. As a small, family-oriented business, DEPLOY"s client provides a compelling benefits package including a generous profit-sharing plan, competitive salaries, and perhaps most importantly, the opportunity to work alongside talented professionals leveraging cutting-edge technologies to solve complex and engaging problems.

Security Platform Engineer (DevSecOps)

The Security Platform Engineer is part of ECI's Security Engineering team and focuses on building, operating, and improving the platform layer that powers security services at scale. This is a hands-on engineering role with strong emphasis on Elastic platform operations, telemetry pipeline reliability, and lifecycle management. You will design and maintain data ingestion patterns, platform standards, and operational controls that ensure security data is reliable, performant, and ready for detection and response use. Own platform-side client lifecycle readiness including onboarding standards, technical validation, and production go-live criteria.
Build and maintain platform observability using metrics, logging, health checks, and operational runbooks.
Partner with Automation Engineering to provide stable data contracts and platform interfaces for detection and workflow delivery.
Collaborate in architecture and operational review practices to raise engineering standards across the function.
Explore and apply AI-assisted engineering practices to improve platform reliability, telemetry quality, operational documentation, and delivery efficiency.

Strong understanding of telemetry ingestion, parsing, normalization, enrichment, and schema management.
Experience troubleshooting distributed platform issues across ingestion, indexing, search, and data lifecycle.
Practical experience with platform lifecycle operations including upgrades, patching, configuration management, and performance tuning.
Experience working with REST APIs and integration patterns in operational environments.
Working knowledge of Linux administration in engineering environments.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms and services, including IAM, networking, and secure integration patterns in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Foundational understanding of detection and incident response concepts within security operations.
Preferred
Experience administering enterprise SIEM or security analytics platforms in production, especially Elastic Security.
Hands-on experience with Elastic Stack platform operations, including Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana.
Familiarity with data retention strategy, index lifecycle management, and storage optimization in high-volume environments.

title: Contract Platform Engineer - AI Agent Infrastructure & DevOps
description_preview:
Burshteyn Polin LLP is a technology-forward litigation boutique focused on AI, crypto, cybersecurity, complex business disputes, and class and mass actions. We are technical lawyers who code and build software to improve how legal work is investigated, developed, verified, and presented.
The firm is growing, and its software platform is scaling with it. We are adding an engineer to our existing contract engineering team. The new engineer will work alongside our lawyers and the contract engineers who have helped make the platform robust. Our lawyers function as product managers who can code, and our engineers bring the technical depth needed to build and operate reliable systems at scale.
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who can understand a complex working platform, make sound architectural decisions, and improve it without slowing product development.
What you will do
Improve the architecture, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability of a mixed Python, JavaScript/Node.js, PowerShell, and web-application codebase.
Make AI and automation workflows more deterministic through clear schemas, reliable state management, idempotency, concurrency controls, bounded retries, and strong error handling.
Maintain and scale our existing Git-based development lifecycle and CI/CD pipeline, and strengthen automated testing, staging, deployment, monitoring, and rollback systems.
Develop, debug, and operate software across Windows, macOS, Linux, and cloud environments.
Maintain and improve AWS infrastructure, secrets and key management, IAM, logging, backups, and disaster recovery, together with services such as Netlify and Supabase.
Improve multi-model coding and agent harnesses that use Claude Code, OpenAI GPT and Codex, Grok, Fireworks AI, and other model and inference providers.
Improve observability, model routing, evaluations, caching, and token, cost, and latency controls.
Work directly with our lawyers and the existing contract engineering team to document systems and prioritize improvements.
What we are looking for
Strong platform, backend, infrastructure, DevOps, or site-reliability engineering experience.
Strong Python and JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js skills are required, along with the ability to work effectively in a mixed codebase that includes PowerShell.
Hands-on AWS experience is required, including cloud operations, IAM, secrets management, security, and infrastructure automation.
Experience developing and troubleshooting across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, reproducible environments, and safe deployment and rollback systems.
Practical experience with LLM or agent systems, including tool calling, structured outputs, context and token management, evaluations, caching, rate limits, retries, and provider APIs.
Strong debugging and security judgment across APIs, asynchronous and concurrent processes, browser or desktop automation, dependencies, and confidential data.
Clear communication, ownership, and comfort treating lawyers as technical product partners.
Engagement
This is a remote hourly contract engagement expected to require approximately 10-20 hours per week. Compensation is $50-$100 per hour, depending on seniority, experience, and scope.
To apply, please send a resume or LinkedIn profile and links to a GitHub profile, portfolio, or representative work. Include a short note about a system you improved or scaled, how you approached it, and what became measurably better.

title: AI Engineer, Voice and Realtime
description_preview:
Obble screens and interviews candidates over a live call. That means audio in, transcription, a model deciding what to ask next, and speech back out, inside the pause a person will tolerate before it feels broken.
This role owns that pipeline: the realtime worker, the prompts, the vendor seams behind them, and the evaluation harness that tells us whether a change made the interviewer better or only different.
What you will do
Own the realtime interview worker: audio handling, speech-to-text, model calls, and turn-taking under a latency budget.
Design prompts as engineering artifacts, versioned and measured against a frozen corpus rather than adjusted by vibes.
Run the evaluation loop: build the scenarios, read the transcripts, and defend a change with numbers before it goes live.
Keep the vendor layer swappable. Models and speech providers change; the product should not have to.
What we are looking for
Strong Python, and experience shipping something that called a language model in production rather than in a notebook.
Comfort with asynchronous and streaming code, and the debugging that comes with it.
A measurement instinct: when a model output is wrong, your first move is to build the case that proves it.
Care about the person on the other end of the call. A candidate is being interviewed by this system, and that deserves real thought.
Nice to have
WebRTC, LiveKit, or any realtime audio stack.
You have run evaluations or A/B comparisons on model output before.

Company Description
By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.
Why join Harvard Medical School?
Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership.
You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine.
Job Description
The SBGrid Consortium at Harvard Medical School supports a large international research community by curating and distributing a scientific software platform used across structural biology, cryo-EM, and related fields. The platform includes approximately 650 software titles and 6,000 versions across macOS and Linux and is deployed across laptops, workstations, HPC clusters, and cloud environments. We are hiring a Scientific Platform Engineer to help lead the modernization, security, reliability, and engineering evolution of this platform. This is a platform engineering role with substantial independent responsibility for CI pipelines, reproducible packaging, deterministic installation, release engineering, runtime hardening, observability, and software supply-chain integrity. The role is designed to be primarily engineering and platform-development work, not routine support, and it directly impacts software delivery and platform reliability across a globally distributed scientific infrastructure.
What You Will Work On: This is an engineering-heavy role – expect 90%+ project/building time vs break-fix.
Build & Test Automation
Design and implement CI pipelines for scientific software across macOS and Linux.
Develop regression and smoke test harnesses for packaged software.
Catch failures before distribution rather than after client installation.
Support fast-moving development branches (e.g., nightly builds) safely.
Reproducible Packaging
Help define and enforce a canonical build contract.
Improve dependency tracking and version control.
Enable deterministic rebuilds across environments.
Contribute to artifact integrity and metadata tracking (e.g., SBOM readiness).

Add tests and versioning discipline to SBGrid’s runtime wrapper system (“capsules”).
Introduce feature flags and safer rollout mechanisms.
Improve logging, observability, and error classification. Internal Tooling & Observability.
Develop dashboards and structured signals around build failures and common error states.
Reduce reliance on tribal knowledge by encoding workflows into systems.

Core platforms

macOS (strong): building, testing, and release workflows across Intel + Apple Silicon
Build/release + automation

Scripting and automation: Bash + Python (primary)

Nice-to-have context

As our Application Engineer you will provide engineering expertise and guidance of all aspects of the application of FFA CNC system products to support OEM and end users in the purchase and integration of FANUC systems. You will work with customers from initial project development through follow-up support, grow sales and market share of FFA products at assigned accounts.
This is
remote
position, reporting to our Hoffman Estates, IL office. You will be supporting customers throughout Western New York and Ontario, including key areas such as Rochester, Buffalo, Syracuse, and the Greater Toronto/Hamilton region. You will either need to reside within a commutable distance of these territories or be willing to relocate to a centrally located area.
How It's Done
Serve as technical lead at assigned OEM/MTB/Retrofitter accounts by:
Suggesting CNC products to meet customer specifications
Supporting commissioning of CNC products for customer’s application
Provide application and marketing support at end-user accounts by:
Providing application support on existing CNC products
Promoting FFA CNC products for key retrofit/new machine projects
Provide technical application assistance and support to Sales Engineers and prospective customers by:
Assisting with pre-installation technical discussion and recommendations - identify technical needs of customers
Accompanying sales engineer on prospective site meetings
Configuring complete systems to determine best technical solution for controls, servos and features
Developing BOM (bill of materials)
Providing new ideas and strategies for the application of CNC products in and outside of the machine tool industry
Assist the marketing & business development team to promote FFA products by:
Create technical presentations and white papers
Attend trade shows and give technical presentations
Support the Engineering Team and overall business goals by:
Providing required reports that highlight major customer activities together with brief hourly breakdown
Keeping manager aware of any difficult customer issues
Updating and maintaining Application Engineering calendar with their whereabouts when not working from the office
Support follow Application Engineering Team members by:
Writing Application Engineering reports and share findings on first time use of new products and functions
Providing product feedback and new product development requests to FANUC Japan as required
Liaise with FANUC Japan through formal technical questions only when issues cannot be resolved locally using existing documentation resources
Pass on new product knowledge to peers through internal, external and on-site training
Ability to travel at least 50% by plane or car domestically with possible international travel
What You Need
High School Diploma
3 or more years of engineering experience within manufacturing, automation, or machine tool industry setting
Valid driver’s license and passport, along with the ability to travel approximately 50%—by both land and air—to customer sites throughout the U.S. and Canada
Knowledge of FANUC CNC products, including CNC controls, servos, spindles, and software tools such as FAPT Ladder, FANUC Picture, Manual Guide i, Macro‑Executor, FOCAS development, and related applications
Extensive knowledge of engineering principles, application development, and manufacturing processes, with emphasis on CNC, PLC, and servo systems
Ability to effectively present ideas and solutions to audiences ranging from machine tool operators to upper‑level management
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks and customers, ensuring timely follow‑through and closure
Strong commercial mindset with technical sales skills
What Would Be Even Better
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or a related field
Three or more years of engineering experience within manufacturing, automation, or machine tool industry setting
It's Your Move
At FANUC America, we are driven by a deep respect for our people and a commitment to building a workplace dedicated to integrity and excellence. We believe that great careers are built through opportunity, growth, and collaboration—and we’re excited to invite talented individuals like you to explore what’s possible with us.
Joining FANUC means becoming part of a team that values your unique perspective and encourages continuous learning and collaboration. We foster a culture where respect and innovation go hand in hand, and where your contributions help shape the future of automation and robotics.
If you're ready to take the next step in your career, we invite you to apply today. We look forward to learning more about you!
Benefits
We offer market competitive pay and benefits programs, as well as opportunities for advancement, knowledge and skill development, and recognition of individual achievements. In addition, we offer the following benefits to our employees:
Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
401(k) Retirement Program
Life Insurance
Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Plans
Tuition Reimbursement
Wellness Program
Flexible Spending Accounts
Employee Assistance Program
Flexible Benefit Dollars
Generous Holiday & Vacation Program

description_preview:
About Black Forest Labs
We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.
Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.
Why This Role
Large-scale training is where research ideas become real, and where many of the hardest problems are no longer cleanly separated into “research” or “engineering.” A promising architecture only matters if we can train it stably, efficiently, and correctly across large GPU fleets.
In this role, you will be embedded in production training and help where the hardest systems and performance problems arise: attention performance, custom kernels, low-precision training, profiling, memory behavior, data movement, distributed training stability, and throughput regressions. You will work directly with researchers, but your output will often be code, measurements, kernels, debugging tools, and training-system changes that make better research possible.
We are open to a range of seniority for this role. The common thread is deep technical ownership: you should be able to make progress in ambiguous training-system problems, verify your results, and own the outcome.
What You’ll Work On
Improve the performance, reliability, and numerical stability of production training runs for large multimodal generative models
Profile full training steps across model code, attention, kernels, data loading, encoders, communication, optimizer steps, checkpointing, and memory pressure
Implement and validate GPU-level optimizations: fused kernels, attention paths, low-precision matmuls, quantization kernels, CUDA/Triton/CuTe/CUTLASS experiments, and no-compile alternatives where they make sense
Push lower-precision training forward, including FP8 / MXFP8 / FP4-style paths, weight and activation quantization, accumulation choices, convergence risk, and quality tradeoffs against baseline training runs
Work with researchers to translate architecture changes into efficient training implementations, and help distinguish real model-quality progress from changes that only look good in a microbenchmark
Debug distributed training failures: NaNs, loss spikes, silent numerical drift, memory leaks, stragglers, bad nodes, NCCL issues, and throughput cliffs
Build benchmarking and profiling harnesses that make performance claims trustworthy across hardware, shapes, sequence lengths, and training configurations
Help the training team move quickly when an urgent bottleneck appears, while turning repeated failures into better abstractions and tools
What We’re Looking For
Experience working deeply on large-scale training systems, ideally as part of a training group working closely with researchers
Strong PyTorch fluency, including comfort reading and modifying low-level training code rather than only using high-level APIs
Experience with distributed training concepts such as FSDP, tensor/model/context/sequence parallelism, activation checkpointing, NCCL, and overlapping compute and communication
Hands-on experience improving training throughput, memory footprint, or stability in real training runs
Experience profiling GPU workloads with tools like Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, torch profiler, trace viewers, or custom telemetry
Practical GPU performance judgment: you may use modern coding agents and tools as much as you want, but you need the understanding to verify correctness, numerical behavior, and performance, and to own the result
Understanding of low-precision training and quantization tradeoffs: FP8, MXFP8, FP4/NVFP4-style formats, scaling, accumulation, numerical validation, and convergence risk
Good research judgment: you can partner with researchers on ablations, understand what the measurements do and do not prove, and keep optimization work tied to model-quality outcomes
Comfortable operating in ambiguity: sometimes the task is a clean implementation, sometimes it is a production fire, and sometimes it is figuring out which of three plausible explanations is actually true
We'd Be Especially Excited If You
Have supported or co-owned training for a frontier foundation model that shipped or reached a major release
Have written or substantially improved forward/backward GPU kernels, or have shown you can make progress on kernel-level work with strong measurement and validation discipline
Have worked on attention performance, variable sequence length training, non-standard attention patterns
Have experience on Hopper or Blackwell-class GPUs
Have worked on low-precision training
Have experience with diffusion, flow matching, DiT, and multimodal generative model training; if your deepest background is autoregressive or LLM training systems, you are excited to learn the diffusion and multimodal modeling stack quickly
Can move naturally between profiler traces, kernel code, distributed systems failures, and research discussions
How We Work Together
We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Job Description
As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the nation’s top professional services firms, CohnReznick creates rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!
CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices nationwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.
We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a
SAP Engineer III
to join the
Global Digital & CyberSecurity
team.
CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.
WHY COHNREZNICK?
At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Design, develop, and configure SAP S/4 HANA Public Cloud ABAP solutions.

Provide technical support and troubleshooting issues related to ABAP programs.
Enhance SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud modules focusing on Authorization, Data Migration, and Integration techniques as well as recommending best practices or improvements in current product or in the area of ownership for better support or user experience
Monitor and troubleshoot system performance and proactively identify and resolve issues for the SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem integrations
Perform regular system backups and recovery to ensure data protection.
Document system configurations and procedures for future reference and compliance.
Assist in system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem modules and features to enhance system capabilities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and vendors to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.
Develop and execute system improvement plans to optimize performance and efficiency.
Monitor all upcoming changes being deployed by SAP. Work on testing plans and keeping senior staff updated on upcoming changes.

Job Summary
As a design build engineering firm and general contractor that designs and builds food and beverage processing facilities, Dennis Group’s automation & controls engineers work closely with our process, packaging and building engineers to meet our clients’ expectations in startup, commissioning, and qualifying their food and beverage production facilities. The role requires regular onsite presence to ensure necessary diagnoses, troubleshooting, and operational startup of our client’s production lines, equipment, and facilities. Our automation & controls engineers are frequently facing engineering challenges in applying standard engineering techniques to design, develop, and maintain instrumentation or control systems. Both software and hardware design and troubleshooting skills and abilities is required for this role. Typical responsibilities include, but not limited to:
Responsibilities
Handles moderately complex issues and problems and refers more complex issues to higher-level engineer
With general supervision, designs and troubleshoot both software and hardware necessary for control systems utilizing PLCs for integration of manufacturing systems.
Automates manufacturing processes through the use of instrumentation or controls systems.
Design, diagnose, and troubleshoot network infrastructures - Ethernet, DeviceNet, AS-i, Profibus etc.
Develops new PLC applications, interfaces, or embedded controls
Develops new or modifies existing set-up and commissioning of new facilities or upgrading of existing facilities
Design, specify, wire, and procure control panel equipment, e.g. safety circuits, I/O, networks, etc.
Design, specify, and procure electrical equipment, e.g. MCCs, panelboards, transformers, etc.
Specify, procure, configure, and troubleshoot controls hardware and field instrumentation
Assist with coordinating with other engineer disciplines
Troubleshoots and resolves malfunctions and makes recommendations that will improve efficiency or quality of operations
Develop bid documentation for Electrical, Automation, and Low Voltage (network, security) vendors
Documents specifications and operating procedures
Project primary client technical contact
Interface and manage installation contractors during construction
Researching Automation & Controls materials and best practices
Supporting talent growth within our organization
Provide coaching and/or mentoring to a subordinate group when directed by supervisor.
Required Education Skills And Experience
Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
4-7 years of experience with Allen Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, GE Fanuc, Honeywell Systems.
4-7 years of experience in Visual Basic, SQL, MS ACCESS Database programming skills a plus
4-7 years of experience with Design and implement process network infrastructure (Ethernet, Device Net, Control Net, ProfiBus, etc.)
4-7 years of experience in an industrial manufacturing setting
Database programming skills a plus
Proficiency with MS Office and AutoCAD Required
This role is client facing, those successful in this role are professional, self-motivated, and energetic individuals with excellent communication and inter-personal skills.
Must meet travel requirement - you will spend significant time in our client's facilities during installation and startup/commissioning/qualification phases of a project – 35% to 50% of any given time of the year.
Physical Requirements
Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Prolonged periods of standing and walking during installation, commissioning and startup.
Must be able to lift-up to 30 pounds at times.
Travel Requirement
Up to 50% travel required to visit project site and other offices.
About Us
We plan, design, engineer, and build food plants for major brands across the country and the world. For the past three decades, we’ve focused exclusively on the food and beverage industry, helping your favorite brands put your favorite foods in the grocery store. Simply put, food isn’t one thing we do, it’s all we do.
Dennis Group offers competitive compensation packages commensurate with experience. We provide comprehensive employee benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid time off including an open vacation policy, as well as bonus, profit-sharing, and retirement plans.
Dennis Group is proud to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

We solve process, automation, and data integration challenges in therapeutics, energy, and manufacturing with a broad portfolio of product, project, and service capabilities. Our experienced team has a deep knowledge of people, process and systems and relentlessly seeks to drive the outcomes that empower our partners to advance the world. Join in our mission!
The Role
We are looking for an Application Engineer to own the full lifecycle of valve solutions for our customers from first conversation to final delivery. This is not a pure engineering role, and it is not a pure sales role. The best fit is someone who thrives in the space between technical problem solving, customer engagement, and commercial results.
You will work closely with Account Managers and Order Management, bringing your valve expertise directly to customer conversations, and be the person customers trust to get it right.
What You'll Do
Propose and sell valve solutions - including control, isolation, and safety relief valves - by listening to customer requirements and recommending the right configuration, sizing, and application approach
Grow NECI's valve automation business by promoting our reputation as a total valve supplier for ball valves, butterfly valves, valve automation, and complete solutions across a range of industrial customers and process industries
Achieve sales goals for new product initiatives by engaging in NECI and principal product launches, uncovering customer needs, and applying the latest technology offerings
Provide technical support to customers through start-up, calibration, troubleshooting, and issue resolution and follow through until the problem is solved

Identify and develop new sales opportunities while maintaining accurate customer and opportunity data in our CRM platform

Stay sharp by attending factory training, principal-based sessions, and professional development opportunities

Hands-on familiarity with control valves, isolation valves, and/or safety relief valves including sizing, selection, and application

About Gridware
Gridware is a San Francisco-based technology company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the electrical grid. We pioneered a groundbreaking new class of grid management called active grid response (AGR), focused on monitoring the electrical, physical, and environmental aspects of the grid that affect reliability and safety. Gridware’s advanced Active Grid Response platform uses high-precision sensors to detect potential issues early, enabling proactive maintenance and fault mitigation. This comprehensive approach helps improve safety, reduce outages, and ensure the grid operates efficiently. The company is backed by climate-tech and Silicon Valley investors. For more information, please visit www.Gridware.io.
Role Description
We are seeking a curious, hands-on R&D Test Engineer with an instrumentation focus to join our Physical R&D team. You will own the test infrastructure our scientists depend on: designing and building fixtures, instrumenting test systems, developing data collection methods, running experiments, and turning one-off prototype setups into repeatable systems.
Our scientists define what to investigate, and together you collaboratively define how; examples include fixturing, sensor selection, data acquisition, procedure, and controls. You will build the systems that make those tests possible, run the experiments, and ensure they produce trustworthy data. The work spans a wide range of environments, including our lab, warehouse, outdoor microgrid, and future pilot-scale settings, each requiring solutions tailored to the environment and test goals.
You will also be the person who makes test methods durable. When an experiment or test grows past an exploratory stage, you mature it through designing fixtureand sending updates, writing SOPs, or training others.
This role sits on the R&D team, which is responsible for the sensing and measurement performance of our devices rather than their design or implementation. It is not a reliability, qualification, or manufacturing test role. You will not own device design, though what you measure will regularly inform it.
Responsibilities
Develop and improve existing prototype physical experimentation infrastructure. Design and build test fixtures, rigs, and setups in collaboration with R&D Technicians and Research Engineers. Translate guidance and test intent from Research Engineers into a physical setup that produces trustworthy data.
Architect, source, assemble, and operate electromechanical test setups end to end. Scope the build, select and procure components and instrumentation, manage vendors and machine shops, and get it working on the bench and at our test facilities.
Instrument test articles and fixtures: select, mount, wire, and calibrate sensors (including strain gauges, load cells, accelerometers and IMUs, thermocouples, displacement and position sensors).
Set up data acquisition systems using LabView that collects and parses data in a format readily ingestible by down stream data processing pipelines.
Run experiments, with an emphasis on tests that are novel, ambiguous, or still changing shape as researchers continue to learn and gain valuable insights from the test infrastructure you create. Prepare equipment, execute the test, keep clean records, and deliver organized, well-labeled datasets.
Work to improve repeatability via writing SOPs, setup and calibration procedures, and test reports. Train other teams and technicians to run mature test methods, and support the handoff until they are self-sufficient.
Partner with research engineers to turn test intent into an executable plan — asking the questions needed to be confident the test will actually answer the question being asked.
Own our R&D lab and its equipment: fixtures, instrumentation, calibration status, consumables, and safe operation as well as plan and conduct preventative maintenance,
Required Skills
Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or related technical field, plus 3+ years of hands-on test, instrumentation, or lab engineering experience. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome.
Instrumentation fundamentals: sensor selection, mounting and wiring, signal conditioning, calibration, and a working understanding of noise, grounding, sampling rate, and where measurement error comes from.
Electronics bench work: soldering and harnessing, custom cabling, basic circuit troubleshooting.
Practical shop skills: experienced with light power tools, basic fabrication and wiring and harnessing.
Track record designing and executing instrumented tests in an industrial or research setting.
Clear technical documentation: test plans, SOPs, and reports that someone else can follow without you in the room.
Comfortable working with researchers as we learn and adapt to new information: able to plan and execute good tests within a scientific framing that others own, and curious enough to ask the questions that keep the tests providing robust data.
Bonus Skills
Proficiency in LabView (writing data acquisition code, light automation and data processing) and NI hardware (cDAQ hardware, CompactRIO, high frequency modules)
Field and outdoor testing: experience running instrumented tests outside a controlled lab environment.
Test measurement ownership: experience taking responsibility for measurement quality end to end — calibration traceability, verification, repeatability studies, and measurement uncertainty.

The Testing Engineer is responsible for executing test programs that combine hands-on experimentation across a wide range of testing applications and environments, and rigorous data analysis. The role spans the full testing lifecycle - from planning and instrumentation setup through execution, data analysis, and results communication - while ensuring the readiness, calibration, and reliable operation of the test laboratory and supporting equipment. The engineer will also design and integrate new measurement methods and instrumentation, including the associated calibration and system validation work, and will collaborate with development, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver test results that directly inform product and system design decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Interaction: Understand internal and external customer requirements and develop design proposals using Corning products.
Test Planning & Development: Stay current with relevant industry standards, regulations, and measurement requirements. Develop and execute product and system evaluation tests, define testing approaches, and generate tools, processes, and test sequences to repeatedly measure key product characteristics.
Test Infrastructure: Take ownership of the overall condition, readiness, and functionality of the testing laboratory environment. Maintain, troubleshoot, and calibrate complex testing instruments to ensure reliable, repeatable results, and support safe work practices throughout lab and field operations.
Test Execution: Operate project-specific test equipment. Execute in-lab or real-world, in-field testing programs. Troubleshoot testing and infrastructure issues in real time and provide prompt feedback to steer projects in the right direction.
Data Analysis: Analyze raw test data and product characterization results, ensuring data integrity and consistency. Verify observations against first principles and physical models, make critical observations that inform project direction, and summarize findings in clear reports and presentations for internal and customer audiences.
Work Schedule And Travel
Travel up to 20–25%, for 1–2 weeks at a time, mostly across North America.
Flexibility to work occasionally early mornings, nights, and weekends when testing schedules require.
Required Skills And Education
Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related engineering discipline.
2–3+ years of experience in experimental testing, and data analysis.
Ability to operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and calibrate complex technical instruments and diagnostic/testing equipment.
Rigorous approach to experimental planning, execution, and data analysis.
Proficiency in data analysis and management, with experience using Excel and advanced analysis tools (e.g., MATLAB, JMP, Tableau).
Excellent communication skills, including comfort interfacing with third-party vendors and customers.
Self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of equipment and testing operations with minimal supervision.
Desired Skills
Hands-on experience with designing and conducting experiments, and instrumentation handling (operation, calibration, troubleshooting, optimization).
Good understanding of thermal and chemical engineering fundamentals (fluid flow/hydrodynamics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, kinetics, reactions, or mechanics of materials), will consider internship project experience.
Master's degree of PHD degree is a plus with no working experince, will consider internship experince.
Experience with data acquisition systems, telemetry, and large dataset handling using statistical tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab, Tableau).
Familiarity with a broad range of measurement techniques and instrument technologies.
Knowledge of system controls and basic programming skills.
Understanding of ceramic materials and their thermo-mechanical behavior.
Project management skills, with the ability to manage all aspects of a testing project independently.
Physical Requirements
Ability to work in laboratory, mobile lab, and in-field testing environments.
Ability to work safely around testing equipment and instrumentation under a variety of operating conditions.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate combines engineering rigor with strong hands-on capability. They take pride in equipment ownership, enjoy practical work, and are equally comfortable analyzing complex datasets and troubleshooting instrumentation across diverse testing environments. They are adaptable, detail-oriented, and committed to producing high-quality, dependable test results regardless of the specific application or test setting.
This position does not support immigration sponsorship.
The range for this position is $84,658.00 - $116,406.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.
A job that shapes a life.
Corning offers you the total package.

Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. Jobright.ai is looking for a New Grad AI Engineer to build generative AI experiences that help users discover jobs and make better career decisions.
Why Join Us
• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search
Responsibilities
• Build LLM-powered product features and workflows
• Develop prompts, retrieval pipelines, and structured outputs
• Integrate generative AI capabilities with product systems
• Create evaluation datasets and automated quality checks
• Improve output quality, safety, latency, and cost
• Investigate failures and iterate based on user feedback
Qualification
Required
• Recent graduate in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field
• Strong Python programming skills
• Understanding of machine learning and NLP fundamentals
• Familiarity with APIs, Git, and software development practices
• Strong experimentation and debugging skills
Preferred
• Experience with LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, or AI agents
• Familiarity with PyTorch or open-source language models
• Experience building generative AI applications
• Knowledge of evaluation, guardrails, or prompt engineering

title: Computer Engineer - Firmware/Software
description_preview:
This role is part of the Jobright Direct Hiring Network, where top companies like Cresta AI, Plaud, Mercor, OpenArt, and 1,500+ others hire top talent directly through our platform.
This is not a mass job posting. Only select, high-signal candidates are invited and recommended directly to hiring teams
Hiring Company: Key Tech Inc.
One-liner: Key Tech is an engineering and product development consultancy that helps companies design, develop, and manufacture complex medical and life science products.
Salary: $90K/yr - $125K/yr
Why Join Us:
• Founded in 1998, Key Tech brings 25+ years of custom product engineering for medical, industrial, and consumer markets.
• Our primary focus is on organizations developing medical devices, in vitro diagnostics (IVD), life science instruments, pharmaceutical delivery devices, and cell & gene therapy equipment.
• What sets Key Tech apart is our multidisciplinary approach. Our team of engineers and designers work together to solve challenging technical problems while balancing performance, usability, manufacturability, quality, cost, and regulatory requirements.
• Our company culture is hard to beat: we work in a beautifully restored 100-year-old theater and are proud to be a dog-friendly office. Monthly social gatherings, quarterly team events, and a healthy dose of everyday fun create an engaging workplace that complements the satisfying and challenging design work at the heart of our company.
Role Responsibilities
• Do real high-tech engineering of medical devices in a laid-back setting
• Work on continually new and interesting hands-on medical device design work, learning and advancing your career more in one year than at any other company
• Develop embedded algorithms that drive motors, move mechanisms, measure optical signals, and communicate with PC software
• Help pick processors and design embedded architectures that will be in the next generation of medical devices
• Test your code on custom Key Tech-designed boards - see your software in action
• Design a complex code base to control microfluidic flow
• Design a thermal control system which simultaneously measures optical signals
• Create code that controls a pneumatic system for DNA analysis
Qualifications
Required
• 0-5 years of experience in engineering or related field

title: Gen AI Python Developer
description_preview:
Hi
Rameez here from Beaconfire. I hope you're doing well! We’re currently hiring for an exciting
Agentic AI Python Developer
role, and I wanted to reach out to see if you or someone in your network might be interested. This is a fantastic opportunity to work on high-impact projects using modern technologies in a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.
BeaconFire is based in Central NJ, specializing in Software Development, Web Development
and Business Intelligence; looking for a strong agentic AI developer who can build and
productionize Vertex AI–based RAG systems (Vertex AI Search / Vertex AI RAG patterns),
design reliable tool-using agents, and work comfortably with vector databases and graph
databases. You’ll own end-to-end delivery: ingestion, retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation,
and deployment.
Job Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the team to design and develop high quality Web applications using
Python, Flask, Django, and related technologies.
Write clean and efficient code, and ensure code maintainability and reusability.
Design and implement RAG pipelines on Google Cloud / Vertex AI (chunking,
embeddings, indexing, retrieval, reranking, grounding).
Build agentic workflows (tool use, planning, reflection/guardrails, structured outputs)
using Python-first frameworks.
Perform code reviews to ensure code quality and consistency.
Conduct testing to ensure application quality and reliability.
Create and maintain technical documentation for web applications.
Participate in project planning, estimation, and prioritization.
Stay up to date with the latest technologies for Python development.
Define and run evaluation (retrieval metrics, answer quality, hallucination/grounding
checks), and improve system quality iteratively.
Ship to production: APIs, monitoring/observability, cost/performance optimization, CI/CD,
and security best practices.
Requirement:
Experience in software development in Python3.
Decent understanding of the software development/testing life cycle.
Knowledge of relational databases (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc)slanguage skills
Experience with version control tools, such as Git.
Experience building RAG solutions (hybrid search, reranking, chunking strategies,
embeddings, prompt + schema design).
Familiar with at least one agentic framework (e.g., LangGraph/LangChain, LlamaIndex,
Semantic Kernel, AutoGen) and tool/function calling patterns.
Solid knowledge of vector search concepts and at least one vector DB in production.
Strong engineering practices: code reviews, testing, telemetry, secure-by-design,
reliability mindset.
Preferred Qualifications:
Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
1+ year professional experience in Python web application development with either
Flask or Django.
Experience in RESTful API development in Python.
Understanding of Python web application frameworks such as Flask or Django.
Experience with Cloud services, such as AWS.
Experience with Vertex AI and GCP fundamentals (IAM, logging/monitoring, Cloud
Run/GKE, storage).
Knowledge graphs for RAG (entity linking, graph traversal + retrieval fusion).
Streaming/messaging (Pub/Sub, Kafka), document pipelines (Document AI), and
multilingual retrieval.
Experience with evaluation tooling (RAGAS, TruLens, custom eval harnesses),
prompt/version management.
Frontend integration (basic React/Next.js) or platform enablement (internal developer
tooling).
If you're currently exploring opportunities or open to learning more, I’d love to connect. Please feel free to share your updated resume or reach out directly at
rameezk@beaconfireinc.com

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Systems Insights
description_preview:
About Our Client
The organization operates in the industrial data analytics sector, helping businesses transform complex industrial process data into actionable insights that improve profitability and operational performance. As a remote-first company led by experienced entrepreneurs, it combines advanced analytics, software, and a strong culture of innovation and growth.
About the Opportunity
The
AI Customer Insights Engineer
develops scalable intelligence workflows that help Customer Success teams make earlier, smarter, and more strategic decisions. This role transforms customer data into actionable insights, supporting customer health assessments, adoption tracking, risk identification, and renewal forecasting.
This early-career position is well suited for professionals transitioning into analytics and software development. The role offers the opportunity to apply Python, SQL, automation, and AI technologies while working closely with Customer Success and Analytics Engineering teams.
Responsibilities
• Design and implement account-level Slack summaries for Customer Success Managers and leadership.
• Transform product usage and contract data into actionable operational insights.
• Collaborate with Analytics Engineering to build and enhance data pipelines.
• Develop Python-based automation to scale the delivery of customer insights.
• Contribute to customer health scoring and renewal prediction models.
• Identify indicators of customer risk, expansion opportunities, and product adoption.
• Use AI-assisted development tools and modern coding workflows to improve development speed and quality.
• Build lightweight LLM-powered synthesis workflows where appropriate.
• Partner with Customer Success Managers and Analytics Engineers to understand workflows and translate insights into product and engineering improvements.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
• Up to 3 years of experience in analytics, engineering, or technical roles, including internships.
• Proficiency in SQL and strong Python programming skills.
• Understanding of data modeling concepts.
• Familiarity with large language models and AI-assisted development tools.
• Ability to work effectively in ambiguous and evolving environments.
• Strong written communication and analytical skills.
• Demonstrated curiosity about customer behavior, business outcomes, and causal mechanisms.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in process manufacturing or industrial engineering.
• Exposure to business intelligence tools, product analytics platforms, Slack automation or APIs, and modern data pipelines.
Pay Range and Compensation Package
• Base salary of
$115,000 USD
plus variable bonus incentives.
Benefits & Perks
• 12 weeks of paid family leave.
• Unlimited paid time off.
• Internet and mobile phone reimbursements.
• Medical benefits.
• Group term life insurance.
• Short-term and long-term disability insurance with pre-tax benefits.
• Voluntary vision and dental insurance, including orthodontic coverage.
• Vacation bonus program.
• Employee Assistance Program.
• Generous home office allowance.
Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.
Note:
RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.
